module_title: Intermediate Windows Control and Browser Navigation
introduction: This intermediate tier focuses on desktop management shortcuts and specific browser commands (like History and Downloads) that require strict rote memorization for Banking and SSC exams.

core_concepts.title: Desktop and Lock Shortcuts
core_concepts.description:
- `Win + D`: Show or hide the Desktop (minimizes all windows instantly).
- `Win + L`: Lock your PC or switch accounts.
- `Win + M`: Minimize all windows (Note: `Win + Shift + M` restores them).

core_concepts.title: Browser Menu Shortcuts
core_concepts.description:
- `Ctrl + H`: Open browsing History.
- `Ctrl + J`: Open the Downloads page.
- `Ctrl + D`: Bookmark the current webpage.
- `Ctrl + F`: Open the 'Find' bar to search for text on the current page.

core_concepts.title: Page Reloading
core_concepts.description: - `F5` or `Ctrl + R`: Refresh/Reload the current active page.

core_concepts.title: Reopening Closed Tabs
core_concepts.description: - `Ctrl + Shift + T`: Reopen the most recently closed tab. (Pressing it multiple times opens previously closed tabs in reverse chronological order).

important_entities.name: Task Manager Launch
important_entities.significance: `Ctrl + Shift + Esc` directly opens the Task Manager. (While `Ctrl + Alt + Del` opens a security screen where Task Manager is just one option).

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: `F5` does a standard refresh (loads page from cache). If an exam asks for a 'Hard Refresh' (ignoring cached content and forcing a fresh download from the server), the shortcut is `Ctrl + F5` or `Shift + F5`.
Both minimize windows, but `Win + D` acts as a toggle (press it again and all windows come back exactly as they were). `Win + M` strictly minimizes and cannot be undone with a second press.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: H for History, D for Desktop/Download
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Browser: `Ctrl + H` (History), `Ctrl + J` (Jump to downloads). Windows: `Win + D` (Desktop), `Win + L` (Lock).

exam_strategy_tips: In SSC Tier-2, `Ctrl + Shift + T` is a highly tested browser shortcut. Memorize its function: rescuing a tab you accidentally closed.
